commands.name: explain

arguments.name: CATALOGUE
arguments.description: The compiled catalogue assembly to read, for example a package's DiagnosticCatalog.Sonar.dll.

arguments.name: RULE-ID
arguments.description: The rule to explain, for example SA1000.

commands.description: Explain one rule, and print the suppression that  references it.

commands.name: generate

options.name: --assembly
options.description: An analyzer assembly already on disk. Repeat to read  several together.

options.name: --configuration
options.description: Which configuration of --project to read. Defaults to  Release.

options.name: --container
options.description: The name of the static class holding the rules.

options.name: --date
options.description: The generation date to stamp. Pin it to make  regenerating the same inputs byte-identical.

options.name: --language
options.description: Which language's analyzers to read out of a  package. Only cs can be read today, and cs is the default.

options.name: --manifest
options.description: Generate every catalogue declared in a manifest. Paths inside it are relative to the manifest.

options.name: --namespace
options.description: The namespace the generated catalogue declares.

options.name: --nupkg
options.description: A .nupkg already on disk. Its .nuspec names the source unless you say otherwise.

options.name: --output
options.description: Where to write the generated C# source.

options.name: --package
options.description: The NuGet package whose analyzers to read.

options.name: --package-version
options.description: Which release of --package to read: an exact version,  'latest' (latest stable) or 'latest-any'. Defaults to  latest.

options.name: --project
options.description: A project that produces analyzers, already built.  Repeat to read several together.

options.name: --solution
options.description: A solution; reads the projects in it that declare  ProducesDiagnosticRules. Already built.

options.name: --source
options.description: Which configured feed to read --package from. Defaults to every enabled source in NuGet.config.

options.name: --source-name
options.description: What to record as the source. Defaults to the  package's id, the project's assembly name, or the first  assembly's.

options.name: --source-version
options.description: What to record as the source's release. Defaults  to the package's version, the project's, or the assembly's.

options.name: --summary
options.description: Write a Markdown report of what changed, for a pull  request body to carry.

commands.description: Generate a catalogue from a NuGet package, a project, or  analyzer assemblies on disk.
